QS_HOLD_THE_LINE_ASSAULT._comment: Raider waves march on QS_CARAVAN_CONVOY (towerdefenseunits.json); the assault is cleared (REMOVE_ENCOUNTER) once SPAWN_MAX_TRIGGERS have fired and all spawned QS_RAIDER units are dead. QUEST_PARENT ties the spawner's lifecycle to QS_HOLD_THE_LINE_START.

QS_HOLD_THE_LINE_REINFORCEMENT_WAVE._comment: M2 only: SPAWN_TRIGGER:NONE means this spawner never fires on its own -- it is activated on demand by the QS_START_MAP_SPAWNER trigger action (QS_HOLD_THE_LINE_REINFORCEMENTS_PARAMS in verbs-config.json) when the finale combat starts. Exact runtime activation call is unverified (SPEC.md open question #7).
